# Setting up the working directory
```{r setup}
require("knitr")
opts_knit$set(root.dir = "/nemo/lab/cardoso-moreiam/home/users/falism/ATAC/sc_Mm/combined_analysis_final/")
options(bitmapType="cairo")
```
# Loading packages
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ArchR)
library(Seurat)
library(BSgenome)
library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library("GenomicFeatures")
library(parallel)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(factoextra)
library(dendextend)
library(ggdendro)
library(Gviz)
```
# Setting up general ArchR parameters
```{r}
addArchRLocking(locking = TRUE)
addArchRThreads(threads = 64)
```
# Creating files
## Creating genome annotation
```{r}
## Reading in the blacklist for genome annotation
exclude.mm39 <- import.bed("/nemo/lab/cardoso-moreiam/home/users/falism/ATAC/sc_Mm/ref_files/mm39.blacklist.bedbase.14Oct2025.adjusted.bed")

## Converting GTF to a suitable gene annotation format
txdb_metadata <- data.frame(name = "Resource URL", value = "ftp://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-104/gtf/mus_musculus/")
TxDb_mm39 <- makeTxDbFromGFF(file = "/nemo/lab/cardoso-moreiam/home/users/falism/ATAC/sc_Mm/ref_files/Mus_musculus.GRCm39.104.ChrPrefAdded.Final.gtf", dataSource = "ensemblgenomes", organism = "Mus musculus", metadata = txdb_metadata, dbxrefTag = "gene_id")
```
## Creating the reference
```{r}
## Creating genome annotation
filterChr <- seqlevels(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39)[-(1:21)] ## magic number = number of chromosomes we actually want to keep
genomeAnnotation <- createGenomeAnnotation(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39, filterChr = filterChr, filter = T, blacklist = exclude.mm39)

## Creating gene annotation
geneAnnotation <- createGeneAnnotation(TxDb = dropSeqlevels(keepStandardChromosomes(TxDb_mm39), "chrM"), OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, annoStyle = "ENSEMBL")
```
## Creating ArchR files
```{r}
## Reverting back to 1 thread
addArchRThreads(threads = 1)

input_files <- c("../aln/sa011_Mouse_Placenta_e18_M/sa011_Mouse_Placenta_e18_M/outs/fragments.tsv.gz", "../aln/sa030_Mouse_Placenta_e10_M/sa030_Mouse_Placenta_e10_M/outs/fragments.tsv.gz", "../aln/sa032_Mouse_Decidua_e10_M/sa032_Mouse_Decidua_e10_M/outs/fragments.tsv.gz", "../aln/sa051_Mouse_Placenta_e10_5_M/sa051_Mouse_Placenta_e10_5_M/outs/fragments.tsv.gz", "../aln/sa127_Mouse_Placenta_e10_M/sa127_Mouse_Placenta_e10_M/outs/fragments.tsv.gz", "../aln/sa140_Mouse_Placenta_e14_M/sa140_Mouse_Placenta_e14_M/outs/fragments.tsv.gz")

sample_names <- c("sa011", "sa030", "sa032", "sa051", "sa127", "sa140")

ArrowFiles <- createArrowFiles(inputFiles = input_files, sampleNames=sample_names, outputNames = sample_names, geneAnnotation = geneAnnotation, genomeAnnotation = genomeAnnotation, minTSS = 4, minFrags = 1000, addTileMat = TRUE, addGeneScoreMat = TRUE)
```
## Creating ArchR project
```{r}
proj_test <- ArchRProject(
  ArrowFiles = ArrowFiles, 
  outputDirectory = "Data/combined_analysis_v1/",
  genomeAnnotation = genomeAnnotation,
  geneAnnotation = geneAnnotation,
  copyArrows = TRUE)

proj_test <- saveArchRProject(ArchRProj = proj_test, outputDirectory = "Data/combined_analysis_v1/", load = TRUE)
```
## Investigating the saved project and retaining only cells that I deemed good in the individual analyses
```{r}
## Getting IDs of "good" cells
gc_1 <- readRDS("../analysis/Data/SA011/SA011_GoodCellsIDs.rds")
gc_2 <- readRDS("../analysis/Data/SA030/SA030_GoodCellsIDs.rds")
gc_3 <- readRDS("../analysis/Data/SA032/SA032_GoodCellsIDs.rds")
gc_4 <- readRDS("../analysis/Data/SA051/SA051_GoodCellsIDs.rds")
gc_5 <- readRDS("../analysis/Data/SA127/SA127_GoodCellsIDs.rds")
gc_6 <- readRDS("../analysis/Data/SA140/SA140_GoodCellsIDs.rds")

## combining into one long vector
good_cells <- c(gc_1, gc_2, gc_3, gc_4, gc_5, gc_6)

## Subsetting to good cells only
proj_test_2 <- subsetArchRProject(
  ArchRProj = proj_test,
  cells = good_cells,
  outputDirectory = "Data/combined_analysis_v2_onlygoodcells/",
  dropCells = TRUE,
  force = TRUE
  )

length(proj_test$cellNames)
length(proj_test_2$cellNames)

## Save the project
proj_test_2 <- saveArchRProject(ArchRProj = proj_test_2, outputDirectory = "Data/combined_analysis_v2_onlygoodcells/", load = TRUE)
```
## Dimensionality reduction and clustering
```{r}
## Back to multi threading
addArchRThreads(threads = 64)

proj_test_2 <- addIterativeLSI(
    ArchRProj = proj_test_2,
    useMatrix = "TileMatrix", 
    name = "IterativeLSI", 
    iterations = 2, 
    varFeatures = 25000, 
    dimsToUse = 1:30,
    force = T
)

proj_test_2 <- addClusters(
    input = proj_test_2,
    reducedDims = "IterativeLSI",
    method = "Seurat",
    name = "Clusters",
    resolution = 0.8,
    force = T
)

proj_test_2 <- addUMAP(
    ArchRProj = proj_test_2, 
    reducedDims = "IterativeLSI", 
    name = "UMAP", 
    nNeighbors = 30, 
    minDist = 0.5, 
    metric = "cosine",
    force = T
)

p1 <- plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj_test_2, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "Clusters", embedding = "UMAP")
p1
```
## Visualizing different variables on the UMAP
```{r}
## Base option: clusters
p1 <- plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj_test_2, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "Clusters", embedding = "UMAP")
p1

## Show doublet score
p2 <- plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj_test_2, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "Sample", embedding = "UMAP")

## Plot together
ggAlignPlots(p1, p2, type = "h")

## Show TSS enrichment
p3 <- plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj_test_2, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "TSSEnrichment", embedding = "UMAP")
p4 <- plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj_test_2, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "ReadsInTSS", embedding = "UMAP")
p5 <- plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj_test_2, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "ReadsInBlacklist", embedding = "UMAP")
p6 <- plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj_test_2, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "nFrags", embedding = "UMAP")
ggAlignPlots(p1, p3, type = "h")
ggAlignPlots(p1, p4, type = "h")
ggAlignPlots(p1, p5, type = "h")
ggAlignPlots(p1, p6, type = "h")
```
## Markers
```{r}
## Back to single threading
addArchRThreads(threads = 1)

## Computing markers (returns a SummarizedExperiment object)
markersGS <- getMarkerFeatures(
    ArchRProj = proj_test_2, 
    useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix", 
    groupBy = "Clusters",
    bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"),
    testMethod = "wilcoxon"
)

## Converting to a dataframe
markerList <- getMarkers(markersGS, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.05 & Log2FC >= 1")
markerList$C13 %>% as.data.frame()
```
## Visualizing canonical markers to get a further understanding of the structure
```{r}
to_be_viewed <- c("Pgr", "Esr1", "Eva1c", "Hoxa11", "Gramd1b", "Pecam1", "Kdr", "Tek", "Tie1", "Hbb-y", "Epcam", "Cdh1", "Pax8")
p <- plotEmbedding(
    ArchRProj = proj_test_2,
    colorBy = "GeneScoreMatrix", 
    name = to_be_viewed, 
    embedding = "UMAP",
    quantCut = c(0.01, 0.95),
    imputeWeights = NULL
)
p
```

## Exclude cells deemed low quality from the atlas and re-do the clustering
### I will do so by 1) removing cells that I saved in the vector to_be_removed and 2) by excluding the entire clusters that are bad
```{r}
## Bad clusters = 9,11,13
bad_clusters <- proj_test_2@cellColData %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::filter(Clusters %in% c("C9","C11","C13")) %>% rownames()

## Cells deemed bad above
to_be_removed

## Combine
bad_cells <- union(bad_clusters, to_be_removed)
length(bad_cells)

## As ArchR seems to rename clusters arbitrarily, I save a vector of cells should one wish to ever reanalyze the data
saveRDS("Data/combined_analysis_v2_onlygoodcells/ExcludedCells.rds", object = bad_cells)

## Subsetting to good cells only
cells_to_keep <- proj_test_2$cellNames[!(proj_test_2$cellNames %in% bad_cells)]
proj_test_3 <- subsetArchRProject(
  ArchRProj = proj_test_2,
  cells = cells_to_keep,
  outputDirectory = "Data/combined_analysis_v3_afterround1/",
  dropCells = TRUE,
  force = TRUE
  )

length(proj_test_2$cellNames)
length(proj_test_3$cellNames)

## Save the project
proj_test_3 <- saveArchRProject(ArchRProj = proj_test_3, outputDirectory = "Data/combined_analysis_v3_afterround1/", load = TRUE)

## Remove the previous version of the project to not get confused
rm(proj_test_2)
```

```{r}
labelsNew <- c("Monocytes", "uNK", "SynTII", "SynTI1", "SynTI2", "DSC1", "DSC2", "DSC3", "GlyT1", "GlyT2", "Unknown","JZTP", "LaTP", "SpT1", "SpT2", "S-TGC1", "S-TGC2", "YS1", "YS2", "Erythroid", "Endothelial1", "Endothelial2", "Fibroblast", "B-cells", "Macrophages")
labelsOld <- c("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5", "C6", "C7", "C8", "C9", "C10", "C11", "C12", "C13", "C14", "C15", "C16", "C17", "C18", "C19", "C20", "C21", "C22", "C23", "C24", "C25")

## Also add cell type level annotation
cell_types <- c("Monocytes", "uNK", "SynTII", "SynTI", "SynTI", "DSC", "DSC", "DSC", "GlyT", "GlyT", "Unknown", "JZTP", "LaTP", "SpT", "SpT", "STGC", "STGC", "YS", "YS", "Erythroid", "Endothelial", "Endothelial", "Fibroblast", "B-cells", "Macrophages")

proj_test_4$Final_labels <- mapLabels(labels = proj_test_4$Clusters, newLabels = labelsNew, oldLabels = labelsOld)
proj_test_4$Cell_types <- mapLabels(labels = proj_test_4$Clusters, newLabels = cell_types, oldLabels = labelsOld)

## Removing cluster 11
bad_cells <- proj_test_4@cellColData %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::filter(Clusters %in% c("C11")) %>% rownames()
cells_to_keep <- proj_test_4$cellNames[!(proj_test_4$cellNames %in% bad_cells)]
proj_test_5 <- subsetArchRProject(
  ArchRProj = proj_test_4,

  outputDirectory = "Data/combined_analysis_v5_afterround3/",

  force = TRUE
  )

length(proj_test_4$cellNames)
length(proj_test_5$cellNames)

## Save the project

rm(proj_test_4)

## UMAP with new labels
```

## Integrating with scRNA-seq
### Ensuring the gene names are in the same format
```{r}
## Back to single threading
addArchRThreads(threads = 1)

# Integration
sc_Atlas <- readRDS("~/Scratch_MF/Paper/ResourceFiles/Atlases/Complete/MouseCompleteAtlas_FinalVersion_2ndJan2025.rds")

## Renaming gene IDs
counts <- sc_Atlas@assays$RNA@counts
rownames(counts) <- sub(pattern = ".*?-", replacement = '', rownames(counts))
to_be_removed <- rownames(counts)[duplicated(rownames(counts))] %>% unique()
counts <- counts[!(rownames(counts) %in% to_be_removed),]

## Saving meta and creating a new object
meta <- sc_Atlas@meta.data
meta <- meta %>% dplyr::select(orig.ident, organ, preg.stage, nCount_RNA, nFeature_RNA, percent.mt, percent.rr, DF.classifications_0.05, DF.classifications_0.1, cell.type, cell.class)
sc_Atlas <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = "MouseAtlas", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200, meta.data = meta)

## Removing duplicates from the matrix in ArchR. 
genes_archr <- proj_test_5@geneAnnotation$genes$symbol
filt_genes_archr <- genes_archr[!duplicated(genes_archr)]
filt_genes_archr <- proj_test_5@geneAnnotation$genes[proj_test_5@geneAnnotation$genes$symbol %in% filt_genes_archr,]
## Adding a new gene score matrix
#proj_test_3 <- addGeneScoreMatrix(input = proj_test_3, genes = filt_genes_archr, matrixName = "GeneScoreMatrixNoDuplicates", force = TRUE)

## Unconstrained integration
proj_test_5 <- addGeneIntegrationMatrix(
    ArchRProj = proj_test_5, 
    useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix",
    matrixName = "GeneIntegrationMatrix",
    reducedDims = "IterativeLSI",
    seRNA = sc_Atlas,
    addToArrow = TRUE,
    groupRNA = "cell.type",
    nameCell = "predictedCell_Un",
    nameGroup = "predictedGroup_Un",
    nameScore = "predictedScore_Un",
    genesUse = filt_genes_archr$symbol,
    force = TRUE)

plotEmbedding(
    proj_test_5, 
    colorBy = "cellColData", 
    name = "Cell_types")

plotEmbedding(
    proj_test_5, 
    colorBy = "cellColData", 
    name = "predictedGroup_Un")
```

```{r}
## Colour palette
palette <- c("Bcells" = "#7FB3D5",
              "uNK" = "#08519C",
              "Macrophages" = "#3182BD",
              "Monocytes" = "#08306B",
             "Erythroid" = "#6A3D9A",
             "DecidualStromal" = "#E6AB02",
             "EndothelialMaternal" = "#C71585",
              "Fibroblast" = "#A6761D",
             "ParietalYolkSac" = "#969696",
             "LabyrinthTrophoblastProgenitors" = "#005F66",
             "JunctionalZoneTrophoblastProgenitors" = "#007F86",
             "Spongiotrophoblast" = "#009FA6",
             "GlycogenTrophoblast" = "#00BFC4",
             "SinusoidalTGC" = "#33CCD1",
             "SyncytiotrophoblastI" = "#66D9DE",
             "SyncytiotrophoblastII" = "#99E6EA")

## Plotting UMAP
p1 <- ggplot(umap_plotting, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = FinalCellTypeAnnotation_fromRNA)) + geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) + theme(panel.background = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank(), legend.position = "none", legend.justification = "center", plot.title = element_blank(), legend.text = element_text(size = 18)) + scale_colour_manual(values = palette)
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/ATAC_UMAP_Annotated.png", plot = p1, width = 12, height = 10)

## Legend
legend_data <- data.frame(cell_type = names(palette), color = palette)
rownames(legend_data) <- NULL
legend_data$category <- c(rep("White Blood Cells", 4), rep("Other Blood Cells", 1), rep("Uterine", 1), rep("Endothelial", 1), rep("Stromal", 1), rep("Yolk Sac", 1), rep("Trophoblast", 7))
legend_data$cell_label <- c("B-cells", "uNK", "Macrophages", "Monocytes", "Erythroid", "DSC", "Endothelial (M)", "Fibroblast", "Parietal", "Labyrinth progenitors", "JZ progenitors", "SpT", "GlyT", "S-TGC", "SynT I", "SynT II")
legend_data$y <- c(11:8, 6, 4, 2, 11, 9, 7:1)
legend_data$x <- c(rep(0,7), rep(1,9))
legend_data

p_legend <- ggplot(legend_data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = cell_type), size = 5) +  # colored box
  geom_text(aes(label = cell_label), hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.2, size = 4) + # cell type labels
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(legend_data$color, legend_data$cell_type)) +
  # Add category headers as text (we place them manually)
  geom_text(
    data = subset(legend_data, !duplicated(category)),
    aes(x = x - 0.2, y = y + 1, label = category),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 5
  ) +
  xlim(-0.5, 2) +   # space for labels
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


# Save figure
ggsave("Visuals/ATAC_UMAP_Legend.png", plot = p_legend, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
## Heatmap again (replotted)
proj_test_5 <- loadArchRProject("Data/combined_analysis_v5_annotated_peakscalled/")
markerPeaks <- readRDS("Data/CompleteAtlas_Final_MarkerPeaks_Unfiltered_SummarizedExperimentObject.rds")

## Using the source code from ArchR to replot the heatmap (https://rdrr.io/github/GreenleafLab/ArchR/src/R/MarkerFeatures.R); scaleTo - default = 10^4
mat <- as.matrix(SummarizedExperiment::assays(markerPeaks)[["Mean"]])
mat <- log2(t(t(mat)/colSums(mat)) * 10^4 + 1)
heatmap(x = mat, scale = "row")

## Drawing differentialy accessed peaks

heatmapPeaks
draw(heatmapPeaks, heatmap_legend_side = "bot", annotation_legend_side = "bot")
```

```{r}
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = paletteContinuous(set = "comet"))

ggsave(filename = "Visuals/CombinedAnalysis_LaTP_Top10TFs_AdjPVal0.05_log2FC0.5.pdf", plot = ggUp, width = 15, height = 10)
```
### JZTP
```{r}
mlog10Padj <- assays(motifsUp)[[1]]
mlog10Padj
df <- data.frame(TF = rownames(motifsUp), mlog10Padj = mlog10Padj$JunctionalZoneTrophoblastProgenitors)
df <- df[order(df$mlog10Padj, decreasing = TRUE),]
df$rank <- seq_len(nrow(df))

ggUp <- ggplot(df, aes(rank, mlog10Padj, color = mlog10Padj)) + 
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
        data = df[rev(seq_len(10)), ], aes(x = rank, y = mlog10Padj, label = TF), 
        size = 5,
        nudge_x = 2,
        color = "black",
        max.overlaps = 20
  ) + theme_ArchR() + 
  ylab("-log10(P-adj) Motif Enrichment") + 
  xlab("Rank Sorted TFs Enriched") +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = paletteContinuous(set = "comet"))

ggsave(filename = "Visuals/CombinedAnalysis_JZTP_Top10TFs_AdjPVal0.05_log2FC0.5.pdf", plot = ggUp, width = 15, height = 10)
```

```{r}
## Loading the project

                                                FinalCellTypeAnnotation_fromRNA == "GlycogenTrophoblast" ~ "GlyT",
                                                FinalCellTypeAnnotation_fromRNA == "Spongiotrophoblast" ~ "SpT",
                                                FinalCellTypeAnnotation_fromRNA == "DecidualStromal" ~ "DSC",
```
